metaDesc: Join the AXEM-SX digital workshop. Find out how you can contribute to coding, Haitian Creole translations, packaging recipes, and hardware testing.
heroSub: AXEM-SX is crafted with intention. Shape its future by contributing your skills, testing hardware, or translating pages.
newsletterSub: Subscribe to get notified about new ISO releases, package updates, and developer progress. No spam, no telemetry, unsubscribe at any time.
newsletterSuccess: Thank you! You are now subscribed to the AXEM-SX release announcements.
cardCodingDesc: Help improve the Control Hub, create default configurations, or debug system tools. Submitting a Pull Request directly updates the base.
cardCreoleDesc: Help make AXEM-SX accessible to Creole-speaking communities by translating documentation files, system tools, and pages.
cardPackagingDesc: Help curate our 30+ custom packages. Write RPM spec files, package upstream dependencies, and debug build issues in the Open Build Service.
cardHardwareDesc: Test AXEM-SX on your machines and submit reports to our Hardware Lab. Let us know what worked and what didn't so others benefit.
sponsorsText: If you want to support the project financially to cover builder servers, domain registration, and hosting costs, you can sponsor us.
etiquetteText: We follow a restrained, quiet support model: 'Patient releases, quiet maintenance.' Expect responses in days, not hours. Respect, patience, and clear details help keep the workshop running smoothly.
discordSub: Connect with other AXEM-SX creators, share your custom desktop setups, and get peer-to-peer support. New members land directly in #general.
